limits: Repository fixtures and CI do not substitute for an installed Chrome receipt.
TREE_SHA256 identifies installed package paths and bytes; ZIP_SHA256 separately identifies the archive.
A PASS receipt is valid only for its observed extension ID, version, tree hash and registered host.
Qualification revokes nativeMessaging and grants no browser-action authority.
No related CAND item is automatically closed.
next_job: On an authorized Windows device, load the exact ZIP, register the host with its observed extension ID/version/TREE_SHA256, run qualification.html once, and attach the resulting PASS receipt; do not advance to F31 before this evidence exists.
